messages:
alice: Hey team — SummitHealth RFI dropped into my inbox. They want a capability matrix, POC schedule, and a plain-English note on deployment options (hosted / dedicated / private). Also asked for a price ballpark for a 3‑month POC (100M tokens/month + 10k embeddings). Can someone take lead on the tech answers and an attachment?

ben: I can draft the capability matrix. Quick Q: do we include quantization + batching as separate feature rows or fold them under 'cost optimization'?

carla: For procurement they usually want explicit rows. please do both: a short row for 'Quantization support' and another for 'Automated batching/caching'. keeps legal happy.

devon: I'll own the POC ops plan and the deployment note. Will outline hosted vs dedicated vs private with SLA/latency/cost bullets.

alice: Thanks. @ben can you start the matrix and add a short note about fallback model variants for reliability? SummitHealth is very concerned about SSO + KMS.

ben: For fallback we can add a row: "Automated fallback to compatible model variants (same API surface)" — yes. Also adding a "Data residency & encryption" row per request.

carla: On pricing: for a 3‑month POC with that usage, rough hosted cost is around $24k-$30k depending on model family and caching. Dedicated reserved small pool would be ~ $45k/mo reserved (commit), or $25k/mo with burst credits. Need finance to confirm exact numbers.

devon: I'll include a short ops runbook snippet in the attachments: example canary rollout, canary traffic 5% for 24h, automated rollback on latency > 2s or error rate > 1%. Also include example config: 

```
route: summithealth-prod
model: redwood-7b-quant
batching: adaptive
canary: {percent: 5, duration: 24h}
fallback: [redwood-7b-quant-fast, redwood-4x-int8]
```

ben: Uploading the first draft matrix to the drive: https://drive.internal/sales/summithealth/matrix-v1.xlsx (will update).

carla: Good. For security questionnaire: they asked about KMS/HSM integration and SOC/ISO. We should attach our standard security appendix and short KMS answer: we support customer-managed KMS keys via integrations with major cloud KMS; on-prem HSM options available for Private deployments.

alice: @devon can you add a clear line: "Private deployment supports customer-managed KMS (bring-your-own-key) and optional HSM integration" — legal likes explicit language.

devon: Added that line in the attachments doc. Also noted audit log retention options (30/90/365 days) and can confirm longer retention for enterprise add-on.

opsbot: (uploaded) summithealth_rfi_attachments_v1.zip - includes: capability_matrix.xlsx, rfi_answers.md, poc_ops_runbook.md, pricing-estimates.csv

alice: Awesome. Two more asks from SummitHealth: 1) Do we provide customer-managed model weights? 2) Can we run the POC in their AWS account?

ben: For model weights, we don't hand over proprietary Redwood models. For open models from the model catalog we can provide the bits under the model license; however our Redwood-managed performance variants remain on our runtime. I'll add that nuance to the RFI answer.

devon: For running in their AWS account — yes for Dedicated and Private. Hosted can't run in customer account. I'll put a clear table: Hosted = no, Dedicated = possible with peered VPC + reserved nodes, Private = yes (VPC or on-prem).

carla: Finance needs to approve the POC discount. I'll ping them and attach the initial pricing file. Expect a reply by EOD.

alice: Thanks. Can we target sending the RFI bundle by tomorrow morning PST? SummitHealth requested responses within 48 hours.

ben: I can finish matrix tonight and add export as PDF.

devon: I'll finalize the ops runbook and deployment note by 10pm.

carla: I'll wait for the finalized pricing.csv then assemble the zip and upload final.

alice: Great. One last thing — SummitHealth asked for a lightweight performance benchmark on 2k token context for embeddings + generating responses ~512 tokens. Do we have a one-page perf summary?

ben: We have the perf one-pager for redwood-7b-quant and redwood-13b-8bit. I'll grab the numbers and add them as perf_summary.pdf.

opsbot: (uploaded) summithealth_rfi_final_v1.zip - capability_matrix.pdf, rfi_responses.md, poc_plan.pdf, pricing-estimates-final.csv, perf_summary.pdf

alice: Sent to SummitHealth procurement at 2023-09-14T07:24:05Z with note: "Attached RFI bundle + POC plan. Reach out if you'd like a walkthrough demo."

carla: Summit replied: "Thanks — can you confirm SLA for Dedicated under POC? Also need contact for security review."

devon: Reply sent: Dedicated POC SLA region dependent; we can commit to 99.9% uptime for reserved pools during POC, and provide named SE for security review (carla and devon).

alice: Marking this thread resolved once finance confirms pricing and legal signs off on the RFI text. Will follow up in morning. :thumbsup:
